unit: million KZT, stock at the end of the previous quarter (as at the date)
methodology: NBK page «Обзор финансового сектора» (records JSON), quarter-end stocks from 2015-Q1 dated the first day of the next quarter. Item FS.<NBK key>; FS.r_f_s_n_f_o = financial sector's claims on public nonfinancial organisations (1 442 961 mln at 2015-04-01, 5 149 050 at 2026-07-01). Identities enforced: n_e_a = claims - liabilities to nonresidents = liabilities side - domestic claims; i_r = net claims on government + claims on other sectors.
